tabs.description: Groups of actions, each bound to one tab. Actions in a group run in order on its tab; groups run in parallel. A tab id may appear in at most one group per call.

tab.description: A 7-char hex tab id from list, or "new" to create a tab (a "new" group's first action must be open)

output.description:
What the group returns about the page's end state: snapshot when you need element ids to act next; markdown to read page content; html only when markdown drops structure you need; none for no page output (e.g. after close). A snapshot is indented lines of [id] role "name" followed by any value and state the element carries:
  [a3f81c2] heading[2] "Pricing"
  [9c04e1d] textbox "Email" value="ada@example.com" required
  [d7e02f3] checkbox "Remember me" checked
  [5b29c44] combobox "Country" value="United States" collapsed
  [20fa7b8] link "Docs" url="/docs"
State flags that may appear: checked, pressed, disabled, readonly, required, selected, invalid, focused, expanded, collapsed. A heading shows its level as heading[N], and a collapsed control hides its options until you click it. To read only part of a page instead of the whole thing, use the filter fields below (section, includeAXScope, excludeAXScope, includeElementIds, match).

includeElementIds.description: Optional. Return only the subtrees rooted at these element ids, instead of the whole page. Each is an element id from a snapshot (not a tab id), e.g. "a3f81c2". Combines with includeAXScope. A stale id errors so you re-snapshot and retry

includeAXScope.description: Optional. Return only the page regions matching these accessibility selectors, dropping everything else. Each selector is an ARIA role or role:name, e.g. "main", "navigation", "region:About". A selector that matches nothing is ignored

excludeAXScope.description: Optional. Drop the page regions matching these accessibility selectors, removed from whatever the includes kept. Same selector grammar as includeAXScope, e.g. ["navigation", "banner", "contentinfo"] to strip site chrome

match.description: Optional. Keep only output lines matching this regular expression (Go regexp, case-sensitive). Applied last, after any scope or section. Use it to grep a page down to the lines you need

section.description: Optional. Return just one section of the page: the heading whose text matches this (case-insensitive, trimmed), and everything under it through the next heading of the same or higher level, or the page end. The heading itself is included. Use it to read a single section (e.g. "Experience" on a profile, "History" on an article) without the rest of the page. Works with snapshot or markdown output, not html. A name matching no heading errors with the list of headings present, so you can fix it and retry

actions.description: The actions to run in order on this tab; omit to just read the page via output

reason.description: Why, one short sentence; not what. Written verbatim to the audit log; redact secrets and PII

action.description: The verb. Each field below names the actions that use it; close, back, forward, and reload take no extra fields. fill sets a form element's value; type sends real keystrokes to whatever has focus: canvas-rendered editors (docs, spreadsheets, design tools) ignore fill, so focus the editor, then write and send shortcuts with type

url.description: open only. Required for open. The URL to navigate to

id.description: Required for click, hover, fill, select, upload. Optional for screenshot (one element). An element id copied exactly from a snapshot (not a CSS selector or visible text), e.g. "a3f81c2"; an element inside an iframe has a longer dotted id like "a3f81c2.def5678"

text.description: fill or type. For fill: the text to enter; replaces the input's existing content, and empty text clears the field (on contenteditable elements it inserts at the cursor instead). For type (exactly one of key or text): the string to send as real per-character keystrokes to the focused element, for editors that handle keyboard events themselves and ignore fill; US-layout characters only

option.description: select only. Required for select. The visible text of the option to pick

key.description: type only; exactly one of key or text. The key to press, sent as real keyDown/keyUp to the focused element: a key name like "Enter", "Escape", "ArrowDown", "F5"; a single character like "a" or "#"; or a "+"-chord holding modifiers Control (Ctrl), Shift, Alt, Meta (Cmd), like "Control+A" or "Shift+ArrowRight". Names are case-insensitive. In-app shortcuts and selection (Shift+Arrow) work through chords

pixels.description: scroll only. Optional. Signed distance; negative scrolls up; omit for one viewport down

files.description: upload only. Required for upload. File paths to set on the <input type="file">

js.description: eval only. Required for eval. JavaScript expression, not statements; wrap multi-statement code in an IIFE

path.description: screenshot only. Optional. Save the JPEG here; must end .jpg or .jpeg; omit to return the image inline

full.description: screenshot only. Optional. Capture the whole scrollable page, capped at 12000px; mutually exclusive with id

maxHeight.description: screenshot only. Optional. Raise the full-page height cap; only with full

browser.description: Browser-scoped actions; they run after all tab groups complete

reason.description: Why, one short sentence; not what. Written verbatim to the audit log; redact secrets and PII

action.description: list: the open-tab roster (tab, title, url for each)
